title: Ogden, UT — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Ogden is a city in UT with a population of 88,000. Historic rail city at the foot of the Wasatch Mountains with outdoor recreation. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 33.3.
